title: The Permission Gates
description: A permission block that turns advice into enforced gates, with a general ask rule, a bash map, and an edit rule.

steps.description: This is a `permission` block. A rule in `AGENTS.md` is advice the model may ignore; a permission entry is a gate the harness enforces before the tool runs, so the model does not get a vote.
`"*": "ask"` is the general rule: ask about everything not matched by a later rule.
The `bash` value is itself a map of command patterns. It asks about everything, allows anything starting with `git`, and denies anything starting with `rm`.
`edit` is set to `ask`, so file edits prompt you before they run.
